resources.string: Select a location to filter pre-registrations. Use Refresh to check again.
Verify identity before using Confirm arrival. You can reject with a reason or open direct registration.
Search for the patient by document or register a new one. Use NN registration for an unidentified patient.
Check the location and chief complaint before registering arrival. The guide will not read the form data.
Select a location and status to filter encounters. Use Refresh to check again.
Open an encounter to view its details and events. Use Previous and Next to change pages.
Review the encounter details and timeline. If your role allows it, you can cancel it with a reason.
Use Refresh to check again. The guide will not read patient information.
